title: Rabbi Ariel Zadok's chant causes a sudden freeze at Homestead 2

tellings.quote: The temperature drops dramatically around Homestead 2 and right in the doorway.

plain: When a rabbi named Ariel Zadok chanted at Homestead 2, a building on Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, the temperature "drops dramatically" around the building and "right in the doorway". That is what Brandon Fugal, the ranch's owner, tells Michels, describing a visit he says he witnessed sometime in the 2020s. If true, a religious chant set off a physical change at the site.
